Nitish Setu Poster Case : bihar ke vaishali se nitish setu par postar pharne ke mamle men bari khabar samne aaee hai. mamle men pulis ne karravaee karte hue 8 namjad aur 50 agyat logon ke khilaph FIR darj ki hai. pul ke udghatan ke bad postar pharne ki ghatna ko lekar pulis ne janch shuru kar di hai.
Aakhir is mamle men pulis ki karravaee kya hai? dekhie puri khabra.
